interface.title: MetaSprint Dose-Response — Zero-Install Dose-Response Meta-Analysis Platform
interface.field: Evidence synthesis / clinical epidemiology (cardiovascular dose-response meta-analysis)
interface.stage_of_work: Analysis and reporting of a systematic review: entering extracted data, fitting and comparing dose-response models, checking bias and sensitivity, and drafting Methods and Results
interface.what_it_is_for: A single-page browser app that walks a reviewer from protocol to extracted dose-level effect estimates, fits and compares many dose-response curves, checks bias and robustness, and auto-writes Methods and Results text.

data.note: I uploaded alcohol_cvd_dose_response.csv through Extract > Import CSV, which brought in 16 rows across 4 cohorts (screens/003.webp). The 5 reference rows (dose 0, effect 1, no CI) and the Cohort4 2012 20 g/day row with no CI were excluded, which left 11 dose points. No row had a Timepoint, so the strict publishability gate blocked analysis until I turned it off (screens/005.webp, screens/012.webp). The Cohort3 2020 outlier stayed in, and it shows up in the leave-one-out and residual checks. Discover showed a built-in set of 282 cardiovascular RCTs in its cluster map.

tree.general: Pool dose-level effect estimates from several studies into a dose-response curve, judge how robust it is, and report it
tree.specific: Run a dose-response meta-analysis of alcohol g/day vs CVD risk in MetaSprint, from CSV import through model comparison, bias checks and an auto-drafted Methods/Results

screens_never_reached: Discover > DR Landscape content: says 'No dose-ranging trials found. Try loading a subspecialty first'. Loading needs live ClinicalTrials.gov calls (screens/043.webp).
Search results (PubMed/OpenAlex/CT.gov/AACT): these need external network or a local AACT proxy, so I did not run them.
Screen tab with references: no RIS/BibTeX test file was available, so the list stayed empty (screens/049.webp).
Continuous (Mean/SD/N per dose) input mode, Extract from PDF, and Send to TruthCert / Import TruthCert Methods+Results: not tried.
Insights sub-tabs other than Tawakkul and Mizan (Shura, Hikmah, … Registry): not opened.
Gap-to-Protocol (an evidence gap in Discover auto-filling the Protocol PICO): not tried.
not_done: Greenland-Longnecker reconstruction of within-study covariance: no control or output in the interface names it. Only the auto-written Methods text cites Greenland & Longnecker (1992). The one-stage mixed-effects option fits random intercept/slope, but I could not confirm the GLS covariance step from the screen.
Running _runAllDRTests() self-tests: these need a browser console, which this harness does not provide.
Two-stage analysis: the imported per-dose rows were not turned into slopes. The Slope and SE columns stayed empty (screens/055.webp), so I switched back to one-stage without running it.

The generated draft kept [population]/[intervention]/[outcome] placeholders after I filled the PICO fields, and it describes only three candidate models. The PICO values did not flow into it (screens/053.webp). The replay note for t19 says the draft 'uses the PICO'; screen 053 contradicts that, and the tree follows the screen.
The exported R code is labelled 'Model: FP1(3) | Method: REML' while the last fit shown was Emax, and its formula is a linear logrr ~ dose. The export does not reproduce the chosen model.
Forcing DR Model = Emax leaves the heading 'Best model: Emax (lowest AIC)' although FP1 has the lower AIC (screens/031.webp).
Clicking a row in the model-comparison table does not select that model. I had to use the DR Model dropdown instead.
Verify and Flag on registry rows had no visible effect (counters stayed Verified 0 / Unverified 16), since the rows have no NCT link (screens/009.webp).
Clicking DR Landscape in Discover showed only an empty-state message (screens/043.webp).
Ticking 'PICO elements defined' in Checkpoints: a click was made, but no kept screen shows the ticked state (screens/050.webp shows DoD-A at 0/9 before the click).

Credible intervals: according to the source (renderBayesCrIBand, metasprint-dose-response.html:27392), a Bayesian credible-interval band is always overlaid on the DR curve, but it is unlabelled and I could not tell it apart from the confidence/prediction bands on screen. The earlier claim that only frequentist bands are shown was wrong.
